name: Little Lamplight
description: Cave settlement run entirely by children. No adults allowed. Don't ask about Big Town.

name: Ant mound
description: The ant mound is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Black Rock Cave
description: Black Rock Cave, also called Black Rock Cavern, is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Bloodborne Cave
description: Bloodborne Cave is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Broc flower cave
description: The broc flower cave is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Radscorpion Cave
description: Scorpion nest south of Shady Sands. Chitinous clicking echoes off the walls. Tails drip venom in the dark.

name: Toxic Caves
description: Irradiated caverns near Klamath. Golden geckos glow in the toxic murk. A wrecked robot waits at the bottom.

name: Vault 114 (Park Street Station)
description: Subway station hiding an unfinished vault. Triggermen in pinstripe suits patrol the tunnels. Nick Valentine waits inside.

name: Dunwich Borers
description: Granite quarry with Lovecraftian undertones. Deeper you go, stranger it gets. Faces in the stone.

name: Deathclaw Lair
description: Breeding ground in the Boneyard outskirts. The egg mother guards her clutch. Few enter. Fewer leave.

name: Deathclaw Sanctuary
description: A cave system teeming with deathclaws. Bones crunch underfoot. The alpha watches from the darkness.

name: Museum of Witchcraft
description: Salem tourist trap. Something huge nests inside. Body parts on the stairs. A deathclaw and her stolen egg.

name: Andale
description: Friendliest town in Virginia. White picket fences, apple pie, and a basement full of human remains. Don't stay for dinner.

name: Boston Public Library
description: Knowledge gathering dust. Super mutants tore through the stacks. A robot librarian still tries to check out books.

name: Hubris Comics
description: Comic book publisher's office. Ghouls in the printing room. The Silver Shroud costume waits backstage.

name: Jamaica Plain
description: Town hall guarding a pre-war treasure. Laser tripwires and ghouls. The treasure? A time capsule. Worth dying for, apparently.

name: Nipton
description: Burned to ash by Caesar's Legion. Crucifixions line the road. A lottery nobody wanted to win.

name: Sunset Sarsaparilla HQ
description: Bottling plant full of star caps legend. Festus the robot tells tall tales. The prize in the vault isn't what you'd hope.

name: Vault-Tec HQ
description: Corporate headquarters of humanity's worst social experiment. Master terminal holds every vault's dirty secret.

name: Black Mountain
description: Radio tower held by insane nightkin. Tabitha broadcasts madness. Neil warns you to turn back.

name: Faneuil Hall
description: Cradle of liberty turned super mutant meat locker. Gore bags hang from the rafters of the great hall.

name: Kendall Hospital
description: Hospital overrun by raiders on top, synths in the basement. Two dangers stacked like a layer cake of bad decisions.

name: Mass Fusion Building
description: Pre-war energy company HQ. Contested by multiple factions. A beryllium agitator waits on the top floor.

name: Museum of Technology
description: Rockets and robots gathering dust. Super mutants nested in the planetarium. The dish on the roof still works.

name: National Mall
description: Trenches dug between monuments to democracy. Super mutants and Brotherhood trade fire where tourists once walked.

name: Necropolis
description: City of the dead. Ghouls shuffle through a ruined cityscape of collapsed overpasses and dry sewers.

name: Pickman Gallery
description: Art gallery where the exhibits are painted in blood. Pickman kills raiders and calls it art. He's not wrong about the raiders.

name: Searchlight
description: NCR camp irradiated by Legion sabotage. Troopers turned feral overnight. Radiation hangs like a curse over the ruins.

name: The Capitol Building
description: Democracy's corpse. Super mutants and mercs fight over rubble that was once a nation's heart.

name: Trinity Tower
description: Skyscraper claimed by super mutants. Rex Goodman held prisoner at the top. Strong waits to understand the milk of human kindness.

name: Dunwich Building
description: Eldritch office building. Reality bends. Flashbacks to pre-war horror. Something dark in the basement.

name: The Cathedral
description: The Master's stronghold disguised as a cult church. Beneath it, a psychic mutant god waits.

name: The Citadel
description: Pentagon ruins converted to Brotherhood of Steel headquarters. Power armor lines the courtyard. Liberty Prime sleeps in the basement.

name: ArcJet Systems
description: Rocket engine factory. Synths patrol the assembly floor. A functional rocket engine sits waiting.

name: Cambridge Police Station
description: Brotherhood of Steel forward base. Paladin Danse holds out against ghoul waves. Distress signal on repeat.

name: Camp McCarran
description: NCR's main base in the Mojave. Old airport terminal. Fiends press against the fences daily.

name: Helios One
description: Solar power plant. NCR can't figure it out. The real weapon is in the basement. Archimedes awaits.

name: Hidden Valley
description: Brotherhood of Steel bunker hidden beneath the desert. Power armor, plasma rifles, and a chapter on the brink of civil war.

name: REPCONN Test Site
description: Rocket facility haunted by invisible nightkin and ghouls seeking a promised land in the sky.

name: Ranger Station Charlie
description: Small NCR outpost wiped out by Legion. Bodies still at their posts. Radio still broadcasting static.

name: Yangtze Submarine
description: Chinese submarine beached in Boston Harbor. Captain Zao still alive inside. Two centuries of guilt and a nuclear warhead.

name: Big MT
description: Secret pre-war research crater. Think tanks, robo-scorpions, and science gone beautifully wrong.

name: Boston mayoral shelter
description: The Boston mayoral shelter is a location in the Commonwealth in 2287, created to shelter the...

name: Fort Constantine
description: Nuclear launch facility. T-51b power armor locked in the basement. Robots and ghouls guard Cold War secrets.

name: Galaxy News Radio
description: GNR broadcasting from a fortified building in DC ruins. Three Dog keeps the signal alive. Mutants keep trying to stop it.

name: HELIOS One Solar Collection Tower
description: The mirror array focuses sunlight into the tower. Archimedes II orbital strike platform. Point it at anything. Anything.

name: Jefferson Memorial
description: Project Purity. Dad's dream of clean water for the wasteland. The Enclave wants it. Everyone wants it.

name: Nellis Air Force Base
description: Boomers territory. Xenophobic tribe with a functional bomber and artillery. Approach means mortar fire.

name: Sierra Army Depot
description: Pre-war weapons storage. AI named Skynet guards the arsenal. Automated turrets and robots patrol in silence.

name: The Castle
description: Fort Independence. Minutemen headquarters retaken from a mirelurk infestation. Radio Freedom broadcasts again.

name: The Nucleus
description: Submarine base on the Island. Children of Atom worship the warhead inside. Radiation thick as fog.

name: Adams Air Force Base
description: Enclave mobile base crawler. Vertibirds launch from cracked tarmac. The Brotherhood's final assault ends here.

name: Enclave Oil Rig
description: Poseidon Energy offshore platform. Enclave HQ. FEV Curling-13 ready to purge the wasteland. The Chosen One ends it here.

name: Hoover Dam
description: The prize everyone wants. Power, water, and control of the Mojave. The final battle happens here.

name: Mariposa Military Base
description: FEV production facility. Vats of green mutagenic slurry and the Master's army. Ground zero for mutantkind.

name: Mothership Zeta
description: Alien spacecraft in orbit. Abductees from across time held in cryo. The death ray points at Earth.

name: Navarro
description: Enclave forward base on the coast. Vertibirds, advanced power armor, and shoot-on-sight protocols.

name: Raven Rock
description: Enclave headquarters. President Eden's bunker complex. Deathclaws guard the perimeter.

name: Sentinel Site
description: Nuclear missile silo in the Glowing Sea. Warheads still racked. Ghouls in military uniforms guard the launch controls.

name: The Glow
description: West-Tek research center, ground zero of a direct nuclear hit. Radiation so intense it glows green. Brotherhood sends initiates here to die.

name: Combat Zone
description: Pre-war theater turned fighting arena. Raiders bet on cage matches. Cait fights for her freedom every night.

name: Corvega Assembly Plant
description: Car factory turned raider fortress. Catwalks, turrets, and Jared's gang holding court in the press room.

name: Raiders Camp
description: Khans' stronghold in the wasteland. Garl Death-Hand rules with a fist. Tandi's kidnappers. The first raiders you'll face.

name: Springvale School
description: Elementary school turned raider den. Chalkboards covered in crude drawings. Chem lab in the basement where kids once played.

name: Super-Duper Mart
description: Grocery store fortified by raiders. Shopping carts as barricades. The produce section is full of corpses now.

name: Cottonwood Cove
description: Legion staging area on the Colorado. Slave pens, crucifixions, and a boat to the Fort.

name: Evergreen Mills
description: Industrial complex crawling with raiders. A behemoth caged in the foundry. Someone's brilliant idea of a guard dog.

name: Libertalia
description: Floating raider city built from lashed-together boats. Former settlers turned pirates. The desperation is architectural.

name: Nelson
description: NCR camp overrun by Legion. Crucified troopers line the road. The Legion flag flies where the bear once did.

name: Nuka-World
description: Pre-war theme park taken by three raider gangs. Cotton candy, roller coasters, and ultraviolence.

name: Paradise Falls
description: Slaver compound in a shopping center. Cages full of people. Eulogy Jones in a pre-war suit, counting caps.

name: Quincy Ruins
description: Fallen settlement held by Gunners. Snipers on the overpass. Power-armored commander on the church roof.

name: Saugus Ironworks
description: Foundry run by the Forged. Initiation means walking through fire. Slag the foreman uses the blast furnace for discipline.

name: The Pitt
description: Pittsburgh's irradiated steel mills. Slaves work the furnaces. Raiders run the show. The river burns.

name: Weston Water Treatment
description: Water plant taken by super mutants. Vats of irradiated water. They're building an army and they need the water to do it.

name: Agatha's house
description: Agatha's house is a small, single room house in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

name: Arroyo
description: Tribal village descended from the Vault Dweller. Drought is killing the crops. The Chosen One's journey starts here.

name: Bradley's shack
description: Bradley's shack is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Brewer's beer bootlegging
description: Brewer's beer bootlegging is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Canterbury Commons
description: Small trading hub. Caravan merchants stop here between runs. The Mechanist and AntAgonizer feud nearby.

name: Covenant
description: Covenant is a location and possible Commonwealth settlement in 2287.

name: Diamond City
description: Fenway Park reborn as a fortified settlement. Green walls, market stalls, and synth paranoia.

name: Goodneighbor
description: Of the people, for the people. Hancock's ghoul utopia. Freedom, chems, and a neon heart.

name: Goodsprings
description: Tiny Mojave settlement. Doc Mitchell patches you up. Sunny Smiles teaches you to shoot. Simple, kind, doomed.

name: Junktown
description: Trading post built from car parts and corrugated tin. Gizmo runs things from the casino.

name: Klamath
description: Trapper town on the edge of civilization. Gecko pelts, moonshine, and whispers about Gecko City.

name: Lucky 38
description: Tallest tower on the Strip. Mr. House lives inside, sealed for two centuries. The penthouse suite awaits the courier.

name: Megaton
description: Settlement built in a crater around an unexploded atomic bomb. The bomb still ticks. Nobody seems worried.

name: Modoc
description: Farm community on the edge of extinction. Ghost farm, missing people, and a dark secret underground.

name: NCR Capital
description: Shady Sands grown into a proper nation's capital. Government buildings, rangers, and bureaucracy blooming in the desert.

name: New Vegas Strip
description: Neon oasis in the desert. Three casinos, a cowboy robot army, and Mr. House pulling every string.

name: Rivet City
description: Aircraft carrier beached in the Potomac. The most civilized place in the Capital Wasteland. Rusted but safe.

name: Sanctuary Hills
description: Your old neighborhood. Picket fences and dead lawns. Build it back or let it rot.

name: Shady Sands
description: First settlement outside the vaults. Adobe walls, brahmin pens, and people rebuilding from nothing.

name: Sloan
description: Quarry workers' camp. They can't work because deathclaws took the quarry. Chomps Lewis paces and worries.

name: The Tops
description: Rat Pack casino run by Benny and the Chairmen. Ring-a-ding-ding, baby. Check your weapons at the door.

name: Underworld
description: Ghoul settlement inside the Museum of History. Neon sign above the door. Smooth-skins tolerated.

name: Vault City
description: Pristine walled city built by Vault 8 survivors. Clean water, medicine, and profound elitism.

name: 188 Trading Post
description: The 188 Trading Post is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Abandoned BoS bunker
description: The abandoned BoS bunker, officially Bunker 13,Abandoned BoS bunker terminal entries; Terminal...

name: Acadia
description: Synth refuge atop a mountain on the Island. DiMA leads escaped synths seeking identity. Fog rolls below like a sea.

name: Arefu
description: Tiny settlement on an overpass bridge. The Family lurks below, drinking blood. Not vampires. Worse: people pretending.

name: Broken Hills
description: Uranium mining town where humans, ghouls, and mutants coexist. Tensions simmer beneath the dust.

name: Bunker Hill
description: Caravan hub beneath the monument. Traders, secret synth railroad, and a battle that decides the Commonwealth's future.

name: Concord
description: Colonial town overrun by raiders. Your first firefight, your first power armor, your first deathclaw.

name: Freeside
description: Vegas slums outside the Strip gate. Kings run the streets. Desperate people and the Followers of the Apocalypse trying to help.

name: Gecko
description: Ghoul-run settlement built around a failing nuclear reactor. Toxic, green-tinged, and stubbornly alive.

name: Jacobstown
description: Super mutant refuge in the mountains. Marcus keeps the peace. Nightkin pace the perimeter, twitching.

name: New Reno
description: Sin city of the wastes. Four crime families, boxing rings, casinos, and enough jet to cloud a vault.

name: Novac
description: Motel town guarded by a dinosaur. Boone watches from the mouth with a rifle. Don't ask about his wife.

name: Primm
description: Roadside casino town overrun by convicts. The roller coaster still works. The sheriff doesn't.

name: Redding
description: Gold mining town caught between NCR, Vault City, and New Reno. Wanamingos infest the mines.

name: San Francisco
description: Shi and Brotherhood outpost. Oil tanker in the harbor. Ancient culture meets post-apocalyptic tech.

name: Tenpenny Tower
description: Luxury high-rise for the wasteland elite. Tenpenny watches the wasteland through a sniper scope. Ghouls want in.

name: The Den
description: Slaver town. Jet addicts in the gutters, dealers on every corner. Metzger runs the flesh trade from a fortified building.

name: The Hub
description: Pre-war shopping center turned trading capital. Caravans arrive daily. Money talks, bullets listen.

name: Westside
description: Community garden behind concrete walls. Mean Sonofabitch guards the gate. Fiends circle like vultures outside.

name: Boat to Dry Wells
description: The boat to Dry Wells is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Far Harbor
description: Fog-shrouded island off Maine. Three factions, radioactive fog, and things that hunt in the mist.

name: The Boneyard
description: Ruins of Los Angeles. Gangs control different blocks. The Gun Runners sell from a fortified factory.

name: Vault 101
description: Beneath the Capital Wasteland. Never opened — until now. Fluorescent lights flicker over decades of isolation.

name: Vault 111
description: Cryogenic preservation facility. Two hundred years of frozen sleep end in a thawed nightmare.

name: Vault 13
description: Home vault of the Vault Dweller. The water chip failed, starting everything. Now sealed and silent.

name: Vault 21
description: Every dispute settled by gambling. Perfect democracy of the dice. House gutted it and poured concrete in the lower levels.

name: Vault 108
description: Cloning lab gone wrong. Every resident is named Gary. They say nothing else. Gary. Gary. Gary.

name: Vault 11
description: Annual sacrifice required or everyone dies. They voted who to kill. The election campaigns got ugly. The truth is worse.

name: Vault 112
description: Tranquility Lane simulation pods. Residents trapped in a virtual 1950s nightmare by a mad scientist.

name: Vault 114
description: Unfinished vault in Park Street Station. Designed to torment the wealthy. Triggermen use it as a hideout.

name: Vault 15
description: Collapsed and picked clean by raiders. The entrance is a hole in cracked earth. Wind howls through empty corridors.

name: Vault 19
description: Split into red and blue sectors by Vault-Tec. Paranoia was the experiment. Powder Gangers found it first.

name: Vault 81
description: Still sealed and functional. Secret lab behind the walls where mole rats carry engineered disease. The residents don't know.

name: Vault 88
description: Massive unfinished vault beneath Quincy quarries. Prototype Vault-Tec devices await a new Overseer with flexible morals.

name: The Institute
description: Beneath MIT. Clean white corridors and manufactured humans. The boogeyman of the Commonwealth is real.

name: Vault 106
description: Psychoactive drugs pumped through the vents ten days after sealing. Hallucinations bleed into reality down here.

name: Vault 12
description: Necropolis vault. The door was designed not to close. Vault-Tec's radiation experiment. Every resident became a ghoul.

name: Vault 22
description: Overrun by mutant vegetation. Spores drift through green-lit hallways. The plants are hungry.

name: Vault 3
description: Opened peacefully, then the Fiends moved in. Drug-addled psychos in a vault meant for decent people. Motor-Runner holds court.

name: Vault 34
description: Flooded with radiation. Ghoulified vault dwellers patrol waterlogged corridors. Geiger counter screaming.

name: Vault 75
description: Beneath a school. Children bred and tested for genetic perfection. Failed subjects harvested. Gunners own it now.

name: Vault 92
description: Musicians selected for preservation. White noise experiments drove them feral. Beethoven echoes through blood-smeared halls.

name: Sierra Madre
description: Pre-war casino resort sealed in toxic cloud. The treasure inside drives men mad. Begin again.

name: Vault 87
description: FEV research facility. The source of Capital Wasteland super mutants. Green hell beneath the earth.

name: Megaton Bomb
description: Undetonated atomic warhead in a puddle of irradiated water. Children of Atom pray to it. Burke wants it lit.

name: Oasis
description: Green paradise in the Capital Wasteland. Trees grow here. Harold the tree-man is the reason. He wants to die.

name: Starlight Drive-In
description: Movie screen still stands over a field of rusted speakers. Drain the irradiated puddle and build something new.

description: The Aerotech Office Park is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

description: The Allied Technologies offices are a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

description: Andrew's clinic is the primary source of medical care for the residents of the Courtyard.

description: Big John's Salvage is a location in the Commonwealth in 2287.

name: Bitter Springs
description: Refugee camp haunted by massacre. NCR gunned down fleeing Khans here. Boone can't forget. Neither can the ghosts.

name: Blue Paradise Vacation Rentals
description: Blue Paradise Vacation Rentals is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

name: Bob's Iguana Bits
description: Bob's Iguana Bits is a food stand operated by Bob Frazier in the Hub in Fallout.

description: Breakheart Banks is a location in the Commonwealth in 2287.

description: Cal's gun shop is a shop in the PMV Valdez owned by Cal in 2241.

description: Cavern is a random encounter in Fallout 2.

description: The Charles View Amphitheater is a location in the Esplanade neighborhood of Boston in 2287.

description: The Council Hall is the government district of the capital of the New California Republic.

name: Den slave run
description: Den slave run is a location in Fallout 2, in the vicinity of the Den.

description: Fake Vault 13 is a small cave north-northwest of New California Republic in 2241.

name: Glendale
description: Glendale is a mentioned-only location .

name: Golgotha
description: Golgotha is a graveyard located on the outskirts of New Reno .

name: Grayditch
description: Abandoned suburb near DC. A kid scientist's fire ant experiment went wrong. Very, very wrong.

description: Grisham's house is the home for father Grisham, daughter Miria, and son Davin in Modoc Main...

description: Hollywood was a municipality of Los Angeles that was known for its celebrities and film...

description: Hollywood Hills was a pre-War residential neighborhood in Los Angeles, California which...

description: The Hub is a major location .

description: Jenna's general store is a store in the PMV Valdez owned by Jenna in 2241.

description: Los Angeles, abbreviated as LA, was one of the largest cities in the United States.

description: The maintenance center, currently staffed by Valerie, is Vault City's premier workshop...

description: Molerat Mambo is a blood sport gambling establishment in the Redding mining camp where mole...

description: The NCR Rangers HQ is a location in New California Republic's capital.

description: New California,Steve: "{103}{}{Hello and welcome to Vault City, the best city in New...

name: Nipton Road Rest Stop
description: Abandoned gas station on a lonely highway. Cazadors hunt the ridge above. The Mojave doesn't forgive carelessness.

name: Pacific Ocean
description: The Pacific Ocean, referred to by some tribals as the Great Salt Water,Chosen One...

description: The Presidential Mansion is a location within the Council Hall in NCR town.

name: The Basincreek Building
description: The Basincreek Building is a location in the Mojave Wasteland .

description: The wasteland, or simply the wastes, is the name generally given to the landscape of the Earth...

name: Zion Canyon
description: Pristine canyon untouched by bombs. Tribal conflict brews beneath red sandstone cliffs and waterfalls.

name: Abandoned car fort
description: The abandoned car fort is a small makeshift fort in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

description: Abernathy farm is a location and potential settlement in the Commonwealth in 2287.

name: Alexandria Arms
description: The Alexandria Arms is a location in the Capital Wasteland in 2277, near Arlington Library.

description: Anacostia Crossing Station is a Metro station and the southernmost point stop on the Red Line.

description: The Beantown Brewery is a location in the Commonwealth in 2287.

description: The Bethesda ruins are located northwest of Washington, D.C.

description: The Capital Wasteland is a loosely defined geographic region, spanning areas of Virginia...

description: The Chestnut Hillock reservoir is a lake in the Commonwealth in 2287.

description: The Coast Guard pier, officially the US Coast Guard Charles River Station,Coast Guard pier...

name: Coastal cottage
description: The coastal cottage is a location and a possible settlement in the Commonwealth in 2287.

name: County crossing
description: County crossing is a location and settlement in the Commonwealth in 2287.

name: Crater of Atom
description: Blast crater in the Glowing Sea. Children of Atom worship in the most irradiated spot on Earth. Virgil hides nearby.

name: Minefield
description: Suburban block rigged with frag mines on every doorstep. A sniper watches from the rooftops. Step carefully.

name: Point Lookout
description: Maryland swampland. Fog rolls thick over boardwalks and mansions. The locals aren't friendly.

name: Sierra Nevada
description: The Sierra Nevadas are a mountain range in the former American state of California.

name: Spectacle Island
description: Island in Boston Harbor. Kill the queen, flip the switch, claim the biggest settlement in the Commonwealth.

name: The Commonwealth
description: The Commonwealth is a geographic region on the post-War North American continent, largely...

name: Boston Common
description: Swan's Pond. Looks peaceful. A behemoth named Swan sleeps beneath the water. Don't wake him.

name: Deathclaw Promontory
description: Rocky outcrop on the Colorado River. Largest deathclaw colony in the Mojave. Dozens of them. Turn back.

name: Dry Wells
description: The Courier's nuclear option. What remains of a Legion camp after the warheads fell. Marked men patrol the ruins.

name: GNR Building Plaza
description: Fountain plaza before the radio station. A behemoth charges through the rubble. Brotherhood scribes scatter.

name: Lonesome Road
description: Highway torn through collapsed earth. Warheads embedded in the rubble. ED-E beeps nervously. Ulysses waits at the Temple.

name: Old Olney
description: Suburban ruin overrun by deathclaws. Every building, every alley. The sewers underneath are worse.

name: Quarry Junction
description: Limestone quarry. Deathclaw breeding ground. The shortcut to Vegas that nobody survives.

name: The Divide
description: Nuclear scars ripped through the earth. Perpetual storms, irradiated horrors, and Ulysses waiting at the end.

name: The Glowing Sea
description: Ground zero of the 2077 strike. Permanent radiation storms. Only the hardiest or most desperate venture in.
